Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly synthesized the retrieved data, swapping and fabricating birth dates for the two directors. Despite WebSurfer providing correct information (Jason Michael Brescia born 1986-06-19 and Oscar Barney Finn born 1938-10-28), the Planner listed Brescia as born in 1943 and Finn as born in 1986, leading to the wrong conclusion that Brescia was born earlier. This is a data integration/logic error and a premature finalization without validating the compiled dates.
